docs/specs/background-sessions.md:BG-10: a reply is the next prompt and answers nothing that was asked

docs/specs/session-messages.md:MSG-1: `message_session` has one routing field, the target's name, and one content field, the text
docs/specs/session-messages.md:MSG-2: a message is sent only from a context that has met nothing untrusted, and carries what that context held
docs/specs/session-messages.md:MSG-3: the first message to a session is put to a person, with the target and the whole text
docs/specs/session-messages.md:MSG-4: a second answer covers later messages to the same session for the rest of the turn, and no longer
docs/specs/session-messages.md:MSG-5: a message is delivered to a live process, and starts nothing
docs/specs/session-messages.md:MSG-6: a message never starts a turn
docs/specs/session-messages.md:MSG-7: the receiving planner is told what the text is, in words the driver wrote
docs/specs/session-messages.md:MSG-8: the receiver's driver decides nothing from a message, and a message is nothing a person types
docs/specs/session-messages.md:MSG-9: a message arrives with the label it was sent under, and the receiver can only lower it
docs/specs/session-messages.md:MSG-10: a session sends a bounded number of messages
docs/specs/session-messages.md:MSG-11: both transcripts show the message, and the trail records that it happened
docs/specs/session-messages.md:MSG-12: a delegate and a processor are offered no `message_session`
docs/specs/worktrees.md:WORKTREE-1: `--worktree` starts a fresh interactive session in a worktree made for it
docs/specs/worktrees.md:WORKTREE-2: a name is a label of ASCII letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`, and decides no path
docs/specs/worktrees.md:WORKTREE-3: `--worktree` is refused where a delegate's checkout would be, and where a checkout would not be kept
docs/specs/worktrees.md:WORKTREE-4: a worktree is written, placed, labelled and ruled as a checkout is
docs/specs/worktrees.md:WORKTREE-5: the session works in the worktree as a delegate works in its checkout, and reads its sources from the project directory
docs/specs/worktrees.md:WORKTREE-6: the record is kept under the project directory and names the worktree
docs/specs/worktrees.md:WORKTREE-7: a resume returns to the worktree, and is refused where it cannot
docs/specs/worktrees.md:WORKTREE-8: a worktree is kept until the person removes it, and the sweep never takes one
docs/specs/worktrees.md:WORKTREE-9: a command that begins another session works where this says, and `/cd`, `/branch` and an apply to the worktree itself are refused
docs/specs/worktrees.md:WORKTREE-10: `--worktree` composes with no other way of starting a session
